title: Inputting a bare accent in the editor locks it up
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducable in 4.5.1 and in 4.6rc1
- Note: full problem only applies to Linux / Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS while a slight glitch visible on Mac 15.7.3  too

### System information

Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS - Godot 4.5.1

### Issue description

In any project editing a gdscript file in the built in editor, inputting `´` or the grave accent causes the editor to refuse any further input. Trying to press backspace doesn't remove it, nor does selecting it and pressing delete. The language parser also incorrectly doesn't report any syntax error.
The editor isn't hung though and otherwise responds as usual.

De-focusing Godot sometimes visually removes the accent, but the  editor still doesn't accept any input.

In a small project (a scene or two and one script file) it sometimes allowed editing once or twice after inputting accent but then locked up. 

When it doesn't lock up, it still often removes the accent when de-focusing Godot. This behavior also happens on Mac, but not on Windows.

I don't know if it matters but I'm typically switching between English and Swedish keyboard layouts and the accent bug happens when I press the button that would have been plus or equal sign on English layout but corresponds to the accents on the Swedish layout.

### Steps to reproduce

Edit a gdscript file within the internal editor and accidentally insert a bare accent, for example by writing the following line:

```gdscript
print_debug("This is now locked up"´
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[accentbug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24695428/accentbug.zip)
